text: Water possesses a cold touch. It is of two kinds: eternal and non-eternal. The eternal is in the form of atoms, while the non-eternal is in the form of effects. These are further of three kinds based on the distinction between body, sense organ, and object. The body is in the realm of Varuna. The sense organ is the tasting faculty that perceives taste, located at the tip of the tongue. The objects are rivers, oceans, and so on.
